method.summary: Does the per-venue price a keyless caller gets from CoinGecko's tickers path match the venue it names, and how far behind it is? The job's FIRST measure, protocol version 2: a new sample on its own date, NOT a restoration of the 2026-10-31 v1 sample (m-20261031-coingecko-venue-freshness), whose body log was lost. Four assets x Kraken and Bitfinex = 8 pairs, one CoinGecko call per asset 30 s apart, each venue's tape seconds after, from 120 s before the vendor's last_traded_at. Bitstamp was dropped because its tape comes in whole hours, too large to retain verbatim. Every body is kept in three places (published gzip, the author's repository, an Internet Archive snapshot). PRE-REGISTERED from v1's exploratory reading: figure_precedes, the trade carrying the figure being more than 10 s older than last_traded_at. The prediction was that it holds on at least one pair and that last_traded_at equals timestamp on every pair. RESULT: both held. 8 of 8 answered, none flagged is_stale; 4 of 8 figures sit on the tape within 10 s of last_traded_at, and the other 4 are real trades 13.0 to 18.4 s BEFORE it, so a caller reading that field as the trade time overstates freshness by that much on half the pairs. The vendor's last_fetch_at was 102 to 134 s old on arrival, the tapes had moved 80 to 125 s past last_traded_at, and the figures sat a median 4.1 bps (max 15.5) from the latest trade. POST-RUN, in no row: last_fetch_at precedes last_traded_at on all 8 pairs, and on 6 the figure's own trade is later than last_fetch_at, so that field is not the read time either. NO BASELINE, NO RANKING: one subject.
method.dataset: Four assets fixed before the run (bitcoin, ethereum, solana, litecoin) x two venues whose tapes take a start time (kraken, bitfinex), USD; one CoinGecko coins/<id>/tickers call per asset filtered by exchange_ids; each venue's public trades endpoint seconds later.

results.interval: n=8, min 102.025, max 134.278; four calls 30 s apart

results.metric: median venue tape movement past the vendor's last_traded_at
median absolute deviation from the venue's latest trade
